asset: Napad intact carapace — Resident Evil 6 (2012), LEFT 01

source_refs_reviewed.role: Complete visible 3D render of the intact-carapace form, hosted by a secondary site and qualified by the V18 source audit. The source smoke and solid background are not target anatomy.

visual_checks.orientation: A modest but readable front-left three-quarter direction. The recessed face, jaw projection and leading toes point screen-left. The anatomical LEFT shoulder and arm are prominent on screen-right, and some left side/back plate depth is visible. The chest remains broad and front-readable; this is not a pure lateral profile or a strong side-dominant view.
visual_checks.costume: No clothing, boots or equipment. The heavy crouched reddish-brown body, short thick legs, massive hanging arms and deeply recessed head retain the source family.
visual_checks.hands: Two coherent shoulder-to-arm-to-hand chains; both large hands/fists and both feet remain fully framed. No detached or additional arm. Fine digits and nails are generated interpretation rather than an authenticated count from the dark low-resolution source.
visual_checks.phase: The jagged outer carapace remains present over shoulders and upper back. The high central dorsal plate is attached, and the irregular lateral plates remain asymmetrical. No broken-shell phase, exposed luminous core, new weapon or steam effect is introduced.
visual_checks.framing: One complete creature. Highest plate tip, lateral projections, both hands and both feet remain inside the canvas. No floor, pedestal, cast floor shadow, second subject or scene.
visual_checks.asymmetry: The prominent slanted layered plates beside the anatomical LEFT shoulder remain on that side under the modest rotation; the far shoulder has a different outline. Newly exposed posterior segmented surfaces and precise plate topology cannot be independently reconstructed from the source angle.
limits: Requested TEN PERCENT completely transparent margin is not met. Principal alpha≥16 margins left/top/right/bottom are [104,70,113,84] px = [9.36,4.94,10.17,5.93] %. This is a documented framing deviation, not observed clipping of the subject.

Nonzero alpha reaches canvas edges because of low-alpha residuals. The gray/light composites show no opaque backdrop or substantial visible broad halo; the principal silhouette stays inside the frame. Do not describe the full edge band as strictly alpha-zero.
The direction is front-left with a modest rotation. It supports a LEFT static presentation but does not meet a strict pure-profile requirement.
Exact number, thickness and reverse-side topology of all rocklike plates are not independently proven. The more rounded posterior plates and detailed toes/nails are generated interpretations.
The supplied full render is hosted by a third party. Native mesh, physical scale, original motion, pivot/contact setup and engine admission remain unverified.

uncertain_gates.detail: The source is one frontal three-quarter render, without an authenticated backside.
Fine geometry and irregular relief are not certified 1:1.

alpha.halo_finding: Actual gray/light alpha composites personally inspected. No opaque backdrop or substantial broad visible halo. Some low-alpha residuals reach boundaries; all visible body endpoints are inside the canvas. Hidden RGB was not judged as visible content.

inspection_method: Independent direct comparison of the exact supplied source, the complete prompt, source audit and gray/light alpha composites. Anatomical chains and asymmetric features traced. SHA/dimensions/alpha/bbox independently recomputed; original/archive byte equality verified.
recommended_action: Retain as a complete front-left static candidate of the intact-carapace form, with modest-angle, margin and inferred-geometry limitations. Pair only with an independently generated/reviewed RIGHT; do not mirror.

non_blocking_deviations.detail: Principal margins below 10% and low-alpha boundary residuals; complete subject observed. This is a prompt deviation retained as a limitation, not a full-framing pass.
